body:
The admin Overview starts seven concurrent reads; cold JWKS followers previously received a bare 503 that the client could not recover from without refreshing. The backend now returns bounded, truthful Retry-After advice and exposes it through existing CORS. The shared client retries only GET/HEAD with short numeric advice, keeping two retries, existing backoff, cancellation, signatures, roles and admission limits. Bare/permanent refusals remain visible.

CoB uses its official direct hostname, removing the redirect that exceeded the existing homepage-check budget. Production-network before/after probes changed CoB from timeout to verified HTTP 200 without widening limits. KNBS still serves an incomplete certificate chain; Treasury's certificate expired at 2026-10-31 11:16:02 UTC. Both remain failed observations with safe, specific diagnostics until publisher repair. TLS verification stays on. Homepage reachability grants no ingestion or financial authority.

Validation: 140 affected backend cases normally and under true Python -O, zero skips; full frontend 215 suites / 2,898 passes / zero skips; full TypeScript and changed-file lint clean; actual production build plus all 12 mandatory admin-shell browser cases pass. Three real PostgreSQL/HTTP captures supplied the formerly optional reader prerequisite. Independent Standards passes 31 controls per Python mode; final Spec passes 68 independent plus 48 repository controls. Confirmed review findings have executed RED/GREEN fixtures; the rejected raw-header hypothesis and setup failures remain recorded.

[Release record](https://github.com/Rodgers31/audit_app/blob/253ab29978fdb546b001381861eb767fe84b633f/docs/releases/overview-source-health-20261031.md) · [decision](https://github.com/Rodgers31/audit_app/blob/253ab29978fdb546b001381861eb767fe84b633f/docs/adr/0004-bounded-overview-recovery.md) · [evidence and source pins](https://github.com/Rodgers31/audit_app/tree/253ab29978fdb546b001381861eb767fe84b633f/docs/releases/overview-source-health-20261031).

Publishing, uploads, workers and financial generation remain OFF, verified by read-only production SQL/flags/process inventory. No migration, production business write, source backfill, merge or deployment is included. Production remains on 12b79d361eea0cfb7113d51155bf7a2489a1d076. No new paid resources, paid bot reviews or hosted reruns. Existing Vercel previews are disabled; no settings were changed. Held as a finished draft to avoid automatic paid review; normal CI/deploy workflows remain disabled. No new maintainer override is authorized. #802 and the launch gates remain separate.
